hook_line: A BOTNET HID INSIDE TV BOXES

hook_stat.sub: Android set-top boxes enrolled in the XCPE botnet

stats.label: Infected devices TrendAI counted across 206 models
At least — more compromised devices Google assesses its legal action will sever access to

diaspora_bullets: Low-cost boxes bought for international channels are exactly the class this botnet used
Disconnect a suspect box from the internet — the backdoor reinstalls on reboot
news_summary: Google and partners dismantled the XCPE botnet, which had enrolled more than 1.3 million set-top boxes, and Google says device maker Videostrong intentionally built the backdoor for financial gain.
payoff: Google has banned Videostrong from certified Android devices.
